findings.summary: The `target == "npm-runtime"` branch in `impl bundle` (line 2112) is unreachable, and the 22-line `_bundle_npm_runtime` helper it guards (lines 2086-2107) is therefore dead. Evidence: I grepped the whole repo for callers of `bundle` — the only call site is `jac/jaclang/cli/commands/impl/build.impl.jac:68` (`return bundle(output=output, target=projection, fat=fat)`), which is itself gated one line earlier by `if projection in ["jab", "sealed", "binary", "wheel", "npm"]`, so `target` can never be `"npm-runtime"`. The CLI surface agrees: `jac/jaclang/cli/commands/build.jac:20` declares `choices=["jab", "sealed", "binary", "wheel", "npm", "source", "native"]` and the generated manifest (`jac/jaclang/cli/impl/manifest.impl.jac:166`) repeats the same list — `npm-runtime` appears nowhere. A repo-wide grep for the literal `npm-runtime` returns exactly two hits: this branch and one release-notes line. No test calls `bundle(...)` or `_bundle_npm_runtime(...)`. Deleting both the branch and the helper also drops the now-unused `framework` parameter plumbing (`runtime_pkg_name(framework)` / `build_runtime_to(..., framework=framework)`), which the single dead caller only ever passed as "".
